think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and normal operating range. 2) Check official PostgreSQL documentation for any sentinel/special values (e.g., -1, 0) that switch semantics (disable/auto/infinite). 3) Determine whether such values break the natural numeric ordering by triggering a qualitatively different mode. 4) If yes, mark as special and list the special value(s); otherwise mark as not special.
